description: Turn the wallet's whole wrapped-COOK (wCOOK) balance back into native COOK by closing its wCOOK token account; the account's rent comes back too. wCOOK collects where a venue pays out in it — MomoSwap launchpad referral earnings, NFT sell-backs, swaps run with `unwrapCook: false` — and shows in get_balance as a token on the native mint. Fails early when the wallet has no wCOOK account. Network fee only. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).
name: unwrap_cook
title: Unwrap wCOOK to COOK
